name: qfd_vm_bay_pad15s0

abut_plan.why: the VM lane plan stands relay / pad tiles at 21.6-um pitch (4.32-um channels, pins face to face); this probe routes the fullest bay to measure that channel

slot_change_request: el1011-qwen-tp8.log 2026-10-13 VM4: bay PILOT, not a die slot: the fullest pad-row bay of the tile-level lane plan with a 21.6-um routing frame; the band cluster takes these tiles flat

job.purpose: Qwen TP8 VM lane-bay PILOT (vm_pad_15_S0, the fullest pad-row bay: 6 closed tiles in 6 slots at the plan pitch 21.6 um, 4.32-um channels, 200 lanes of 8 b, 3520 stage bits; wires + hard children only): measures the real congestion / DRC / timing of abutted relay and pad tiles with their closed pins before the band and region clusters are cut. Bench = every lane against its planned me-enabled stage count, every clock; mutants: one lane a tile short, two lanes swapped.
job.hold_merge: physical probe of one lane bay (congestion pilot): the die sees the band cluster, never this block

benches.name: bay_ok
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && $HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator --binary --timing -O1 -Wno-fatal -Wno-WIDTH -Wno-UNUSED -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-PINMISSING -CFLAGS -O0 -j 2 --top-module tb_qfd_vm_bay_pad15s0 -GSEED=1 --Mdir {RUN}/bench/bay_ok rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/bay/tb_qfd_vm_bay_pad15s0.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/bay/ot_qfd_vm_bay_pad15s0.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/bay/ot_qfd_vm_xrelay_w.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xplane.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xpad2.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xtree.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv > {RUN}/bench/bay_ok.build.log 2>&1 && {RUN}/bench/bay_ok/Vtb_qfd_vm_bay_pad15s0 > {RUN}/bench/bay_ok.log 2>&1; tail -3 {RUN}/bench/bay_ok.log; grep -q '^PASS qfd_vm_bay_pad15s0' {RUN}/bench/bay_ok.log
